name: Adrada de Haza (Spain)
description: Square flag with three horizontal stripes of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Adrada de Haza (a castle, a bird, a column and a cross on red and white).
history: Municipal flag of Adrada de Haza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Adrada de Haza arms — castle, bird, column and cross
